entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Comrade Hegel.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Comrade Hegel.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“It's chilly out here. I must go an..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's chilly out here. I must go and try to get some sleep. I'm an old man, after all.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“I recommend you do the same.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I recommend you do the same.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Midnight was approaching as our del..."
entries.dialogueText: Midnight was approaching as our delegation boarded SRS Holsord.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Very well. Good night.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. Good night.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“It is sometimes good to air out on..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is sometimes good to air out one's thoughts.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good idea.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good idea.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will stay a little longer.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will stay a little longer.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We spent a couple of minutes watchi..."
entries.dialogueText: We spent a couple of minutes watching the waves.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“I must go and try to sleep, Mr. Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must go and try to sleep, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The large ship was once the royal y..."
entries.dialogueText: The large ship was once the royal yacht of King Egmund himself. By the order of Soll, it was repurposed to serve the leaders of Sordland for state visits.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Have a good night.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Have a good night.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Mr. President. I am surprised you..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. I am surprised you are still up this late.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I watched the sea for some more tim..."
entries.dialogueText: I watched the sea for some more time before going back to my compartment to sleep.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We departed from the port of Lachav..."
entries.dialogueText: We departed from the port of Lachaven, along with a few other smaller escort boats.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I went back to my compartment to sl..."
entries.dialogueText: I went back to my compartment to sleep.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I silently watched the horizon."
entries.dialogueText: I silently watched the horizon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The dawn arrived and our ship moore..."
entries.dialogueText: The dawn arrived and our ship moored at the busy port of Wilbern.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Amid the usual camera flashes, our..."
entries.dialogueText: Amid the usual camera flashes, our convoy made its way to the train station.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I entered the luxurious compartment..."
entries.dialogueText: I entered the luxurious compartments reserved for heads of state. I lay down on the bed to rest my eyes before we arrived at Wilbern, a major city in Valgsland.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Good point.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good point.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I could say the same thing about y..."
entries.dialogueText: “I could say the same thing about you.”
entries.menuText: “I could say the same thing about you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a short, uneventful ride, we..."
entries.dialogueText: After a short, uneventful ride, we arrived at the central train station of Haelm, the capital city of Valgsland. A huge crowd was already there, awaiting my arrival. They swarmed around me and took photos as I stepped out of the train.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I said it's nothing.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I said it's nothing.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our delegation met with various mem..."
entries.dialogueText: Our delegation met with various members of the Valgslandian cabinet before taking our cars to the Royal Palace. The flags of Valgsland and the CSP were waving next to the entrance.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Anytime, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Anytime, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Assistants took my belongings and l..."
entries.dialogueText: Assistants took my belongings and led me to the museum wing. It was there that I saw Chancellor Hegel. He was inspecting a very large painting on the wall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Markian Sea was known for its t..."
entries.dialogueText: The Markian Sea was known for its treacherous waters, but tonight's trip promised to be rather calm and quiet. Still, I couldn't sleep.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I cleared my throat."
entries.dialogueText: I cleared my throat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I went out to the upper deck to hav..."
entries.dialogueText: I went out to the upper deck to have some fresh air. A light breeze was blowing, and I relished its briny smell. There was nobody here except Deivid.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned around. He was a man of s..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned around. He was a man of small stature with a bald spot and a striking visage. His famous pipe was in his mouth.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you also worried about the fut..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are you also worried about the future all the time?”
entries.menuText: “Are you also worried about the future all the time?”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Do you mind if I ask why you can't..."
entries.dialogueText: “Do you mind if I ask why you can't sleep?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I like taking night walks.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I like taking night walks.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“As mankind, we are forever gullibl..."
entries.dialogueText: “As mankind, we are forever gullible. Always reaching out for what we don't have.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“I used to feel that sleep was wast..."
entries.dialogueText: “I used to feel that sleep was wasted time. Why spend one-third of one's life in the dark?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Chancellor Hegel.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Chancellor Hegel.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“That includes the choices we *coul..."
entries.dialogueText: “That includes the choices we *could've* made, and their results which will never come to pass.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for your wisdom, Deivid...."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your wisdom, Deivid.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“That is precisely why we must be s..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is precisely why we must be strong.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“There is no way out of it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “There is no way out of it.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“It doesn't.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It doesn't.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I can't sleep.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I can't sleep.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Do you mind if I ask why?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Do you mind if I ask why?”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Ah. One of my own.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Ah. One of my own.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's nothing. Don't worry about it..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's nothing. Don't worry about it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I do mind.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I do mind.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you also worried about the fut..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are you also worried about the future all the time?”
entries.menuText: “Are you also worried about the future all the time?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That doesn't help me at all.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That doesn't help me at all.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“No, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“What I realized in time was that w..."
entries.dialogueText: “What I realized in time was that worrying is simply a part of life.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“I'm an old man, Mr. President. I h..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm an old man, Mr. President. I have been alive for over seventy years.”

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“I spent most of those years worryi..."
entries.dialogueText: “I spent most of those years worrying about various things. Endlessly.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My foreign minister was leaning ove..."
entries.dialogueText: My foreign minister was leaning over a railing, gazing out at the inky waves.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“I rather appreciate it now. But th..."
entries.dialogueText: “I rather appreciate it now. But there's still something special about being awake while the rest of the world has its eyes closed."
